title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Management (2016)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Management (2016). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Method of data collection is used to record mass/ collective behavior of people in public place on the basis of observation and interview.
questions.explanation: Mass observation is a method used to study collective behavior through observation and interviews in public places. It combines both structured interviews and observational techniques to understand group behaviors in their natural settings.

questions.questionText: Among the target market strategies one of the following emphasis on two or more difficult groups of potential customers to be identified as target markets, and also a separate marketing mix is developed to reach segment?
questions.explanation: Differentiated marketing targets multiple segments with tailored marketing mixes. It recognizes the differences between market segments and creates unique marketing approaches for each segment, optimizing the marketing effort for different customer groups.

questions.questionText: If total quantity to supply is greater than total quantity demanded, what would you do to solve the problem?
options: Add dummy row, so that supply and demand will become equal.
Add dummy column, so that supply and demand will become equal.
Reduce column, so that supply and demand will become equal.
Reduce a row, so that supply and demand will become equal.
questions.explanation: When supply exceeds demand in a transportation problem, you add a dummy column (representing a dummy destination) to balance the model. This ensures the total supply equals total demand, which is a requirement for solving transportation problems.

questions.questionText: Type 1 error occurs when?
options: We reject H0 if it is True
We reject H0 if it is False
We accept H0 if it is True
We accept H0 if it is False
questions.explanation: Type 1 error occurs when we incorrectly reject a true null hypothesis (H0). This is also known as a 'false positive' in hypothesis testing, and its probability is represented by the significance level (α).

questions.questionText: A definite plan for obtaining a sample from the sampling frame.
questions.explanation: Sampling design is the plan for selecting a sample from a population.

questions.questionText: If a marketer were to divide a market into groups based on consumers' knowledge, attitude, use, or response to a product, the marketer would be using which of the following segmentation forms?
questions.explanation: Behavioral segmentation focuses on consumer responses to products.

questions.questionText: Long-term objectives should be all of the following except:
questions.explanation: Long-term objectives should be stable and not continually changing.

questions.questionText: In which personal selling step does the salesperson tell the product story to the buyer or show how the product will make and save money for the buyer?
questions.explanation: The presentation and demonstration step involves showcasing the product's benefits.

questions.questionText: The most simple and popular method of simple random sample is:
questions.explanation: The lottery method is a straightforward way to conduct simple random sampling.

questions.questionText: How large a sample should be taken to estimate the mean waiting time of patients at a clinic with an error of ±1.5 minutes and 95% confidence? s = 8.37 minutes.
questions.explanation: The sample size calculation leads to a requirement of 130 to achieve the desired precision.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is one of the reasons that personal selling can be more effective than advertising in a complex selling situation?
options: Personal selling is cheaper on a per contact basis.
Personal selling can reach more customers within a given time period.
Personal selling can deal with inelastic demand.
Personal selling can help customers learn more about their needs.
questions.explanation: Personal selling allows for direct interaction and understanding of customer needs.

questions.questionText: ____ refers to one of the special entry modes in international marketing by long-term contact non-core business processes.
questions.explanation: Business Process Outsourcing involves outsourcing non-core business processes.

questions.questionText: Drawing a sample (subset) from a population is:
questions.explanation: Sampling is the process of selecting a subset from a larger population.

questions.questionText: Of the following, one is not an attribute of incremental change.
options: The use of expert authority and persuasiveness
Consensus and collaboration style of leadership and management
questions.explanation: Incremental change typically avoids conflict and focuses on collaboration.

questions.questionText: ______ is the design and management of a system that controls the flow of materials into, through, and out of the international corporation.
questions.explanation: International logistics management oversees the flow of materials in global operations.

questions.questionText: From the following, one is not a characteristic of a good market.
options: Market located in a highly competitive market
Market located at presence of adequate local skills
The none restrictions of Foreign currency
questions.explanation: A good market is not necessarily characterized by high competition. High competition can actually reduce profitability and make market entry more difficult. Good markets typically feature adequate demand, growth potential, limited competition, and fewer trade restrictions.

questions.questionText: Factors affecting productivity include:
questions.explanation: All listed factors significantly influence productivity.

questions.questionText: Identify the reason for resisting change.
questions.explanation: Fear of the unknown is a common reason for resistance to change.

questions.questionText: Among the components of product planning, product development involves:
options: Introducing a new product either by replacing the existing one or innovating a completely new product.
Uniformity in terms of quality, economy, convenience & value.
An emotional decision of withdrawing the existing product line.
questions.explanation: Product development focuses on innovation and replacement of products.

questions.questionText: Control function of management cannot be performed without:
questions.explanation: Planning is essential for effective control in management.

questions.questionText: The means of expanding ownership of the production and distribution chain towards the source of supply.
questions.explanation: Backward integration involves acquiring control over suppliers.

questions.questionText: ____________ is a process designed to maintain or improve current job performance of employees.
questions.explanation: Training is focused on enhancing job performance.

questions.questionText: In regression, the equation that describes how the response variable (y) is related to the explanatory variable (x) is:
options: Used to compute the correlation coefficient
None of these alternatives is correct
questions.explanation: The regression model describes the relationship between variables.

questions.questionText: The Assignment Problem is basically a:
questions.explanation: The Assignment Problem typically aims to minimize costs.

questions.questionText: The correlation coefficient is used to determine:
options: specific value of the y-variable given a specific value of the x-variable
specific value of the x-variable given a specific value of the y-variable
The strength of the relationship between the x and y variables
questions.explanation: The correlation coefficient measures the strength of the relationship between two variables.

questions.questionText: Out of these, which needs the small size sample to see its efficiency?
questions.explanation: Quota sampling can be effective with a smaller sample size.

questions.questionText: Optimal solution of an assignment problem can be obtained only if:
options: Each row & column has only one zero element
Each row & column has at least one zero element
The data is arranged in a square matrix
questions.explanation: In the Hungarian method for solving assignment problems, an optimal solution requires that each row and column has at least one zero element in the reduced cost matrix. This ensures that assignments can be made to minimize the total cost.

questions.questionText: Top level management includes:
options: Department heads, deputy department heads, branch managers, work managers
questions.explanation: Top level management typically consists of the highest-ranking executives.

questions.questionText: The product design stage which deals with the fundamental structure of the production process to be employed in producing a product is:
questions.explanation: The preparation of product design specification is the stage that deals with the fundamental structure of the production process. It outlines the detailed requirements for producing the product including materials, processes, and other specifications needed for manufacturing.

questions.questionText: Based on the below data the range is 32, 35, 36, 36, 37, 38, 38, 38, 39, 39, 40, 40, 42, 45.
questions.explanation: The range is calculated as the difference between the maximum and minimum values. For this data: 45 - 32 = 13.

questions.questionText: ____ is used to inform, persuade, and remind international marketing product?
questions.explanation: Promotion encompasses all activities aimed at informing and persuading customers.

questions.questionText: ____ is the single most impactful element of the international marketing environment.
questions.explanation: Cultural environment significantly influences international marketing strategies.

questions.questionText: The managerial function deals with the measuring and correcting of activities of subordinates to ensure that events conform to plan.
questions.explanation: Controlling involves monitoring and correcting organizational activities.

questions.questionText: "Positioning" is a marketing management aid which refers to:
options: product's ability to provide both immediate satisfaction and social responsibility.
How customers think about proposed and/or present brands in a market.
firm's ability to distribute products through middlemen who are in the right position to reach target customers.
How a firm approaches customer relationship management.
questions.explanation: Positioning relates to customer perceptions of brands in the market.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following marketing philosophies holds that consumers will favor those products that offer the most quality, performance, and features?
questions.explanation: The product concept emphasizes quality and performance as key to consumer preference.

questions.questionText: Statement which shows the minimum acceptable human qualities required for the proper performance of the job is______
questions.explanation: Job specification outlines the necessary qualifications for a job.

questions.questionText: Regression modeling is a statistical framework for developing a mathematical equation that describes how:
options: One explanatory and one or more response variables are related
Several explanatory and several response variables are related
One response and one or more explanatory variables are related
questions.explanation: Regression modeling can describe relationships involving multiple variables.

questions.questionText: One of the following is change resulting from a deliberate decision to alter the organization.
questions.explanation: Deliberate changes are often made to address performance gaps.

questions.questionText: Identify the Features of Advertising play in promoting the product.
options: It is communication by unidentified sponsor.
It is communication by an identified sponsor.
It is a two-way communication between salesmen and the prospect.
questions.explanation: Advertising is typically sponsored by identifiable organizations.

questions.questionText: ____________ is the ability of a product to perform as expected under normal conditions without excessive frequency of failure.
questions.explanation: Reliability refers to consistent performance without failure.

questions.questionText: ______________ is anything that a firm does especially well compared to rival firms.
questions.explanation: Competitive advantage refers to superior performance relative to competitors.

questions.questionText: Method of collecting data which involves presentation of oral verbal stimuli and reply in terms of oral verbal response.
questions.explanation: Interviews involve verbal interaction to collect data.

questions.questionText: Part of management function which actuates the organization members to work efficiently and effectively for the attainment of organizational objectives.
questions.explanation: Leading involves motivating and guiding employees towards goals.

questions.questionText: From the following, one is not the advantage of branding.
options: means of identifying products in a simple way
questions.explanation: All listed options are advantages of branding.

questions.questionText: The type of planning which guides activities that occur over a period of time is:
questions.explanation: Strategic plans provide long-term direction for an organization.

questions.questionText: The amount to which a cash flow(s) will grow over a given period of time when compounded at a given interest rate is:
questions.explanation: Future value calculates the growth of cash flows over time.

questions.questionText: Service strategy that focuses on providing a wide range of services to a limited range of customers.
questions.explanation: Service-oriented focus targets specific customer needs with diverse services.

questions.questionText: ABC Corporation sells only to wholesalers who give their product special attention. ABC Corporation is practicing what type of distribution?
questions.explanation: Selective distribution involves choosing specific wholesalers for product distribution.

questions.questionText: A normal infinite population has a standard deviation of 10. A random sample of size 25 has a mean of 50. When we construct a 95% confidence interval of the population mean?
questions.explanation: For a 95% confidence interval with a sample mean of 50, standard deviation of 10, and sample size of 25, we calculate: 50 ± 1.96(10/√25) = 50 ± 1.96(2) = 50 ± 3.92 = [46.08, 53.92]. Therefore 46.08 ≤ μ ≤ 53.92 is the correct confidence interval notation.

questions.questionText: Which one is not the importance of demand forecasting?
options: Facilitates the management to determine production capacity and raw material
Demand forecast for a specific commodity provides recommendations for demand forecast of associated industries.
questions.explanation: All listed options are important aspects of demand forecasting.

questions.questionText: Based on the below data, the mean will be 32, 35, 36, 36, 37, 38, 38, 38, 39, 39, 40, 40, 42, 45.
questions.explanation: The mean is calculated as the sum of values divided by the number of values. Sum = 535, Count = 14, Mean = 535/14 = 38.21

questions.questionText: Managers who initiate and oversee new projects that will improve their organization's performance play the role of:
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurs drive innovation and improvement within organizations.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is at the core of strategic management?
options: Choosing which organizational objectives to focus on
Being alert for opportunities to change work responsibilities
Adapting the organization to a changing external environment
Choosing whether to make decisions autocratically or on the basis of participation
questions.explanation: Adapting to external changes is fundamental to strategic management.

questions.questionText: Based on the below data, find the median is 32, 35, 36, 36, 37, 38, 38, 38, 39, 39, 40, 40, 42, 45.
questions.explanation: The median is the middle value in a sorted list of numbers. Since there are 14 values (even count), the median is the average of the 7th and 8th values: (38 + 38)/2 = 38.

questions.questionText: The starting point to understanding how consumers respond to various marketing efforts is the:
options: Post purchase dissonance model of a buyer's behavior
Stimulus-response model of a buyer's behavior
questions.explanation: The stimulus-response model explains consumer reactions to marketing stimuli.

questions.questionText: The Assignment Problem is solved by:
questions.explanation: The Hungarian method is a common approach to solving the Assignment Problem.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is not true about reconciliation of cultural differences by international marketers?
options: Managers must be aware of what cultural differences are and how these differences would influence basic functions of management
International managers need to identify the roles that individuals play in the process of cultural change and in acceptance of change
Managers must decide carefully whether and to what extent they should adopt host-country practices to foreign environments
Cultural elements which may resist change should be identified and understood before planning any organizational change
questions.explanation: The incorrect statement is that 'Managers must decide carefully whether and to what extent they should adopt host-country practices to foreign environments.' This is actually a true statement in cross-cultural management. The question is likely intended to ask about a statement that IS true, not one that is NOT true, as all options are valid practices in reconciling cultural differences.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is correct about product standardization and adaptation?
options: Product adaptation deals about firm producing similar products for all markets in the world.
Product standardization means company produces different products for different market segments.
Product adaptation creates negative reactions to local needs.
Main advantage of product standardization is used to save cost.
questions.explanation: Product standardization involves creating uniform products for global markets, with the main advantage being cost savings through economies of scale in production, marketing, and R&D. Options A and B are incorrect because they reverse the definitions of adaptation and standardization, while option C is false as adaptation specifically aims to meet local needs positively.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following consists of non-personal or one-way form of communication conducted through paid media under clear sponsorship?
questions.explanation: Advertising is a paid, non-personal communication method.

questions.questionText: The process used to determine whether an employee is performing according to what is designed or intended.
questions.explanation: Performance appraisal assesses employee performance against set standards.

questions.questionText: The fundamental purpose for the existence of any organization is described by its:
questions.explanation: The mission defines the organization's core purpose and values.

questions.questionText: Which of the following alternative one is not the reason that the firm enters international marketing?
options: Simply the existence of foreign markets.
questions.explanation: A saturated market is typically a reason to exit rather than enter.

questions.questionText: Factors affecting product design include all except:
options: The type and quantity of processing equipment
The size and skill requirements of its workforce
questions.explanation: All listed factors influence product design considerations.

questions.questionText: All of the following are the main objectives of sales promotion activities EXCEPT:
options: To stimulate nonusers to sample a product
questions.explanation: Sales promotions typically aim to decrease price sensitivity, not increase it. When customers become more price-sensitive, they focus primarily on price rather than brand value or product features, which is counter to most promotion strategies that aim to build brand value and differentiation beyond price.

questions.questionText: Factors influencing applicant decisions to recruitment include:
questions.explanation: All factors play a role in influencing applicant decisions.

questions.questionText: The process of searching out and attempting to attract potential candidates who are capable of and interested in filling available positions of an organization.
questions.explanation: Recruitment is the process of attracting suitable candidates for job openings.

questions.questionText: Process flow structure tends to proceed through production without stopping is:
questions.explanation: Repetitive processes are designed for continuous production flow.

questions.questionText: Theory of leadership which focused on what leaders do rather than their traits:
questions.explanation: Behavioral theory emphasizes actions and behaviors of leaders.

questions.questionText: In Northwest corner method, the allocations are made:
options: Starting from the left-hand side top corner
Starting from the right-hand side top corner
Starting from the lowest cost cell
Starting from the lowest requirement and satisfying first

questions.questionText: A numerical characteristic of a population:
questions.explanation: A parameter is a numerical characteristic of a population.

questions.questionText: Products that are consumed in the production process are considered as:
questions.explanation: Materials and parts are used in the production of other goods.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a condition for the existence of annuity?
options: The cash flows must be equal
The interval between cash flows must be flexible
The interest rate applied to be constant
Interest should be compounded during each period
questions.explanation: An annuity requires equal intervals between cash flows—not flexible ones. For an annuity to exist, the cash flows must be equal, occur at equal time intervals, have a constant interest rate, and compound interest should be applied consistently between periods.

questions.questionText: Management by Objectives concept was developed by:
questions.explanation: Peter Drucker is credited with developing the Management by Objectives concept.

questions.questionText: __________ represents the maximum output per unit time given a particular product mix, labor skills, supervision, product quality level, and material quality.
questions.explanation: Design capacity refers to the maximum output achievable under ideal conditions.

questions.questionText: The difference between an agent and a broker is:
options: The agent takes possession of the goods while the broker does not.
Agents are sales representatives while brokers bring buyers and sellers together.
The broker takes possession of the goods while the agent does not.
questions.explanation: Agents represent sellers, while brokers facilitate transactions between buyers and sellers.

questions.questionText: Which one is used for telling the number of observations falling in different categories?
questions.explanation: Nominal scales categorize data without a specific order.

questions.questionText: Out of the given options, which will need the biggest sample size?
questions.explanation: Simple random sampling typically requires a larger sample size to ensure representativeness.

questions.questionText: One is not a contributing factor to the benefits of making a change.
options: The amount of dissatisfaction with current conditions
The availability of a desirable alternative
The existence of a plan for achieving that alternative

questions.questionText: Wholesalers are:
options: Businesses or individuals that sell more of their goods and/or services to final consumers in small quantities.
The middlemen who assist the buyers and the sellers in buying and selling of the goods without taking ownership.
The agents whose main function is to bring into contact between buyers and sellers, and their powers are limited as they cannot fix price, terms of sale.
The middleman who buys from the producer directly and sells it to the retailers on a small scale for the purpose of resale.
questions.explanation: Wholesalers purchase in bulk and sell to retailers for resale.

questions.questionText: Bases of Promotion which implies the knowledge, skills, and performance record of an employee.

questions.questionText: Among the following, one is the marketing task for irregular demand to find ways to alter the pattern of demand through flexible pricing, promotion, and other incentives:
questions.explanation: Stimulation marketing aims to adjust demand patterns through various strategies.

questions.questionText: The reciprocal trading agreement in which goods or services are exchanged for other goods or services is known as ____.
questions.explanation: Counter trade involves exchanging goods or services directly without cash.

questions.questionText: Assume that 0.80 of all 4th year management graduating students can pass the management exit exam. A random sample of 20 students is chosen: 13 passed and 7 failed. What will be the standard deviation of the distribution for the sample proportion?
questions.explanation: The standard deviation of the sample proportion is calculated using the formula: √[p(1-p)/n], where p = 0.80 and n = 20. SD = √[0.80(1-0.80)/20] = √[0.16/20] = √0.008 = 0.089.

questions.questionText: If a hypothesis is rejected at the 0.025 level of significance, it:
options: Must Be Rejected At Any Level
Must Be Rejected At The 0.01 Level
Must Not Be Rejected At The 0.01 Level
May or may not be rejected at the 0.01 level
questions.explanation: If a hypothesis is rejected at the 0.025 level, it may or may not be rejected at the 0.01 level. Since 0.01 is a smaller significance level (more stringent) than 0.025, a p-value between 0.01 and 0.025 would lead to rejection at 0.025 but not at 0.01. However, if the p-value is less than 0.01, it would be rejected at both levels.

questions.questionText: Consider a hypothesis where H0 = 23 against H1 < 23. The test is?
questions.explanation: This is a left-tailed test as it tests for values less than 23.

questions.questionText: The termination or ceasing of the relationship between the organization and the employee.

questions.questionText: Which individuals are most responsible for the success and failure of an organization?
questions.explanation: Strategists shape the direction and success of the organization.

questions.questionText: Straight re-buy occurs when:
options: The organizational buyer chooses from suppliers on an approved list and purchasing department reorders on a regular basis.
The organizational buyer wants to modify product specifications, prices, delivery requirements, and other terms.
The organization/purchaser buys a product or service for the first time.
questions.explanation: Straight re-buy involves routine reordering from approved suppliers.

questions.questionText: The 360-degree performance feedback involves the evaluation of employees by:
options: All who are directly in contact with the rate

questions.questionText: Why use tariff and import quota?

Source of income for the government.
High tariffs and quotas can create black market activity.
Tariffs and quotas can lead to higher prices for consumers.
questions.explanation: Tariffs and quotas generate revenue for governments.

questions.questionText: In the Hungarian method of solving the assignment problem, the row opportunity cost matrix is obtained by:
options: Dividing each row by the elements of the row above it
Subtracting the elements of the row from the elements of the row above it
Subtracting the smallest element from all other elements of the row
Subtracting all the elements of the row from the highest element in the matrix.
questions.explanation: In the Hungarian method, the row opportunity cost matrix is created by subtracting the smallest element in each row from all elements in that row. This process is called row reduction and helps identify the relative costs or penalties of assignments.

questions.explanation: The mode is the value that appears most frequently in the dataset. In this data, '38' appears three times, which is more than any other value, making it the mode.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a key benefit of using a balanced scorecard?

It provides a comprehensive view of organizational performance.
It is easy to implement without any training.
